result.summary: The bottom navigation overlaps the system home indicator, and some text has low contrast.

issues.description: The system home indicator runs across the bottom navigation, obscuring parts of the search and receipt icons.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding and position the navigation controls above the home indicator.

issues.description: The promotional banner’s white supporting text has low contrast against the brighter green background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or use a darker text color to improve readability.
